notes.title: Demo Update! 6/16/2025
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/f2cada63c445121ed1ca7bada63bf512bd791fbb.png"]
Previously LootLocker was used for leaderbaords, which was not tied to anyone steam account and caused crashes when not loaded properly. Often usernames were rejected because of content filters. Now everything is tied to your steam account!



Whats New?

Steam Achievements - share your demo progress with your friends! 

Steam Leaderboards - prove your skills to the world! 

miscellaneous visual improvements and bug fixes during gameplay 



Looking forward to seeing your scores!

notes.title: Demo Beta Available!
notes.content:
BETA TESTING FOR THE DEMO IS AVAILABLE!

Request access by sending us a message on Twitter/X @VintermGames

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45436521/2bf345262b635d4f58814e065ab4c6cb0fee8ade.png

Demo Includes:

Overloaded - No Escape Map
Leaderboards (reset Monthly)
UNLIMITED NON-STOP ZOMBIES KILLING!! 

All bones, coins and achievements earned in the demo will carry over to the full game, where you can buy upgrades, maps and skins!
